$description: RADD design tokens (radd, W3C DTCG). Mode-independent primitives live under `core` and `breakpoint`; every colour scheme is resolved per mode as `mode.light.<scheme>` / `mode.dark.<scheme>`. DTCG has no native modes concept, so the light/dark switching is a naming convention — see MODES-AND-SCHEMES.md. The semantic layer lives once under `foundation`: each token aliases its default context (see `foundationDefaults`), and a contextual one carries `$extensions["com.desquared.radd"]` `{ layer, path }` to re-target it at any other mode, scheme or breakpoint.

com.desquared.radd.foundationContext: A foundation token with $extensions["com.desquared.radd"] { layer: "scheme", path } resolves to mode.<mode>.<scheme>.<path>; { layer: "breakpoint", path } resolves to breakpoint.<breakpoint>.<path>. Its $value is that resolution for foundationDefaults.
